scenes.title: NOTHING CAN BE ERASED
scenes.sub: except maybe in a black hole?
scenes.say: One rule of physics: nothing is ever truly erased. Black holes might break it.

scenes.title: Burn a book
scenes.label: SCRAMBLED, NOT GONE
scenes.say: Burn a book and the words scramble into smoke and ash. Scrambled, but still in there.

scenes.title: Throw it into a black hole
scenes.label: SAME GREY HEAT
scenes.say: Throw it into a black hole, and the heat coming out looks the same every time. No words.

scenes.label: YEARS of physicists arguing about it
scenes.src: posed in 1976 · new math (2019) says the info gets out, but nobody knows how
scenes.say: Physicists have argued about this for fifty years. New math says the info gets out. Nobody knows how.

scenes.title: DOES THE INFO COME OUT?
scenes.say: Does the information come out? Comment yes or no. Part six: what is actually inside?
